note: Campground and mobile home park on Currituck Sound at Knotts Island, at the Virginia line: sandy beach, 200-ft dock for fishing and mooring, boat ramp free to guests, crabbing, playground, plus a waterfront log cabin and other rentals. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 150 sites (80 full hookup, 30 water/electric, 40 primitive) and a pool. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed water/sewer (full hook-up sites), the posted rates effective 4/1/2024 ($45 E/W, $50 full, $10 less Oct 1-Mar 31; fees left as recorded) and the 15% active-duty military discount. Added showers, year-round camping (off-season rates posted Oct-Mar), reservable by phone with a 50% deposit. Cleared the RoverPass-derived 150-site count. Note rewritten (dropped 'Year-round', and the site counts and pool are now attributed to directories). Not stated: amperage, site count, max rig length.
flags: Long-stay character: the operator calls it 'a Campground and Mobile Home Park' offering 'Mobile Home sites for year-round living or vacation getaway'. It posts nightly campsite rates, so test 2 passes, but the share of sites sold nightly is not stated (the site map is an image); a human may want to check test 4.
Price gate: base $45 (E/W, April-September; $35 off season) under US$50; within 34 km of the Virginia Beach gateway anyway. Family has not stayed here.
